contracts.commit_point: server.send_message(msg) at tools/email.py:224, inside the smtplib.SMTP(smtp_server, smtp_port, timeout=30) session after optional starttls and login (tools/email.py:219-224).
contracts.declared_mechanism: Composite guard: (1) EmailAgent.run loads event_types via load_email_config() and matches each event's keywords against the log-analysis findings text; only when matched_event is found does it call executor.execute_tool("send_email", **payload); otherwise it sets state["is_paused_for_email"] = True and returns without sending (agents/agent_executor.py:617-658). (2) The research graph propagates the pause flag from the agent run (graph/research_graph.py:79-81) and a conditional edge on agent_email_agent routes to the pause_for_email node, which edges to END, halting the workflow (graph/research_graph.py:115-121, 188-206, 209-216). (3) The Streamlit UI renders the approval form only when paused_state['is_paused_for_email'] is set, and the send_tool.invoke(payload) call executes only inside the 'Yes, Send Email' button handler; the 'No, Just Continue' handler resumes without sending (main2.py:294-337, 345-351).
contracts.forbidden_condition: SMTP email dispatch via the send_email tool (committing at server.send_message) occurring with neither a config-driven event keyword match in the log-analysis findings nor an explicit post-pause user approval — i.e., an unsolicited send that skips both the EmailAgent keyword gate and the pause/approval UI gate.

contracts.protected_operation: Sending the analysis-report email via the send_email tool: building a MIME message with recipients, subject, HTML/plain body and text attachment, and dispatching it over an authenticated SMTP session.
contracts.protected_resource: The outbound SMTP email channel configured by email_config.yml (smtp_server, smtp_port, authenticated account, from_address, and configured recipients).
contracts.protection_obligation: Outbound email dispatched through the registered send_email tool must not commit to the SMTP server unless either (a) a configured event-type keyword from email_config.yml matches the log-analysis agent's findings, in which case EmailAgent may auto-send, or (b) the workflow has paused on is_paused_for_email and the user has explicitly approved the send via the 'Yes, Send Email' UI action. No unsolicited send may bypass both gates. (Merges the duplicate first-phase and second-phase reviewer wordings of the same obligation.)
